# elseif

Continue an indented conditional branch using the Lua spelling.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Stable ID | `block.elseif` |
| Origin | Lua base |
| Category | Blocks |
| Family | Conditional |
| Monaco kind | `block` |
| Format | `elseif <condition>:` |
| Valid contexts | `executable` |
| Autocomplete | `elseif condition:<br>    -- body<br>` |

## Transformation

## Example

